test_title: SSC CGL (2022) Tier-II Official Paper (Held On : 7 March 2023)
subject: general
question:
‘A # B’ means ‘A is the brother of B’.

‘A @ B’ means ‘A is the daughter of B’.

‘A & B’ means ‘A is the husband of B’.

‘A % B’ means ‘A is the wife of B’.

If D @ N @ H & Y @ F % V, then how is Y related to D?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/94f0af2bd93b93688d2c6092e652fb2d84f74342de195154154b4e73abc5a0da.png] 

Given :

 
 

 
 
A is

 
 
 

 
 
Symbol

 
 
 
#

 
 
 
@

 
 &
 %
 
 

 
 
Meaning

 
 
 
Brother

 
 
 
Daughter

 
 Husband
 Wife
 
 

 
 
to B

 
 
 

Given statement : D @ N @ H & Y @ F % V

So,

 
• D @ N → D is the daughter of N.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f2d23014e54014bfd8d8fb6b974af65131bb41996f5af5fe5806671898da248f.png] 

 
• N @ H → N is the daughter of H.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9d8fde130b1a1bc7280f7ff0e96f3567eba587e4fd87c554630689a021747359.png] 

 
• H & Y → H is the husband of Y.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/be57096ed3897d2c3373f97ec3c03e11a49c0c92cf2abcb6123196d981ae3d8c.png] 

 
• Y @ F → Y is the daughter of F.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3caa4cdd08d7f68cd79e5a67dce461311f7bf57a7a099edc39f1e65b46459d3b.png] 

 
• F % V → F is the wife of V.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/599831ae3b4fed20d3f29ca34eb429fda512bdaf25a07fd7a24450f74c993251.png] 

Thus, according to the final family tree Y is the grandmother i.e mother's mother of D.

Hence, "**Mother’s mother**" is the correct answer.
